title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: Sierra Leone has ratified 45 ILO Conventions and 1 Protocol, with 32 currently in force. However, the country has not ratified any new Conventions in the past 4 years. While it has demonstrated commitment by reporting on key Conventions in the past years, including those on equal remuneration and non-discrimination, challenges remain in consistently fulfilling its reporting obligations to the ILO. The Committee of Experts on the Application of Standards has identified gaps in the implementation of certain ratified Conventions and has issued recommendations for legal and policy reforms. In addition, the government in collaboration with the social partners are working towards the ratification of C190 on Harassment and Violence at the Workplace, C169, C183, C170, C174 and C184.
